description: CfC Stanbic Holdings Limited is a Kenya-based holding company, engaged in the banking sector. The Bank's activities are structured into three business segments: Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB), which provides commercial and investment financial services, such as global markets, transactional products and services, investment banking and wealth management and advising to larger corporate, financial institutions and international counter parties; Personal and Business Banking (PBB) provides banking services, such as mortgage lending, installment sales and finance leases, card products, and transactional and lending products to individual customers and small to medium sized enterprises, and Financial Services, provides stock broking, equity research and primary market. The Company subsidiaries include CfC Stanbic Bank Limited and CfC Stanbic Financial Services Limited.
